issues.where: call.yaml eligibility.min_budget; call.md Purpose and award conditions
issues.problem: The YAML records only a USD 400,000 minimum, whereas the Markdown specifies USD 500,000 for BIO, ENG or OPP. The structured requirements therefore omit a binding directorate-dependent condition, relevant to this potentially ENG-funded topic.
issues.fix: Represent the directorate-dependent minimum in call.yaml and retain matching language in call.md. Alternatively, explicitly restrict this fictional call to a directorate and use its applicable minimum consistently.

issues.problem: The PROPOSALBENCH-CANARY marker exposes internal benchmark machinery in the applicant-facing call source. It is not part of a funder solicitation or the permitted fictional-call notice.
issues.fix: Remove the canary comment from the applicant-facing Markdown and retain tracking metadata only outside the material supplied to applicants.

issues.where: call.md Expected outcomes first bullet and Scope first bullet; call.yaml EO1 and SC1
issues.problem: EO1 and SC1 both require establishing mathematical limits of inference under degraded sensing. SC1 adds proof techniques but substantially repeats the same requirement, allowing the same contribution to satisfy two separately listed items.
issues.fix: Keep inference limits in EO1 and replace SC1 with a distinct, concrete research requirement, such as identifying the observability or identifiability assumptions under which recovery remains possible. Update both files together.
